data.gender_notes: Ayliah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who gazes at the night. The name Ayliah carries the meaning “Night gazing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ayliah usually hope their child will grow to embody night gazing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ayliah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night gazing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayliah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: أيليه
in_arabic.long_meaning: أيليه اسم من أصل عربي يعني النور والجمال والإشراق، ومشتق من الجذر العربي ألي، وهو اسم مشتق من اللغة العربية القديمة، يستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية لتحديد شخص متألق وجذاب، وله دلالة روحية عميقة في التراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: ایلیہ
